messages.subject: Confusion matrix and RISK?
parts:
Hi

Is there a way to combine the use the confusion matrix and the RISK parameter when I run random forest?

I try to explain with an example.  Let’s say that I have 20 True Positive and all of them has a RISK_Adj of 2 points each and I have 10 False Positive with RISK_Adj 1 points each.  I want to see the sum of all the TP(=40 points) and then the sum of all the FP(=10 points).

How do I do that?

Regards,

Rolf
